verdict.rationale: Graphics performance is a fair question for a GPU, so the axis applies. But the evidence pack positions the H200 SXM purely as a data-center AI/HPC accelerator. Its claims cover LLM inference, HBM3e bandwidth and HPC speedups, with no claim of 4K or high-refresh gaming and no independent game benchmarks.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
